import unittest
from normalizer import normalize_build_output

class T(unittest.TestCase):
    maxDiff = None
    def test_large_build_log(self):
        trace = ''.join(f'TRACE noisy diagnostic {i:05d} ' + ('x' * 80) + '\r\n' for i in range(900))
        raw = 'start\r\n' + trace + 'ERROR decisive failure\r\nfinished\r\n'
        self.assertEqual(normalize_build_output(raw), 'start\nERROR decisive failure\nfinished\n')
